( Case study 04 )AI · Creative agency

Ideabro

Launch videos, brand films and explainers for an AI creative agency — and an Instagram grown to 16K followers.

( Overview )

Ideabro is an AI creative agency, and its content had to prove a point most agencies only claim: that AI can make creative work with real taste. We produced its launch videos, brand films and explainers, and grew its Instagram into a channel that works as both portfolio and pipeline.

( 01 — The challenge )

AI creative is everywhere, and most of it looks the same. Ideabro needed to stand apart from generic AI output, explain what it actually does, and reach the brands that would hire it.

( 02 — Our approach )
  1. 01

    Launch videos

    Launch content that introduced Ideabro with energy and clarity: what the agency does, who it is for and why it is different.

  2. 02

    Brand films

    Films that show the quality of the work instead of describing it, setting the visual bar for the whole brand.

  3. 03

    Explainer videos

    Clear explainers that make the AI creative process easy to understand — the how behind the results.

  4. 04

    Instagram growth

    A consistent rhythm of showcases, behind-the-scenes and trend-led posts, turning the feed into a living portfolio.

( 03 — What we made )
  • Launch videos
  • Brand films
  • Explainer videos
  • Reels
  • Showcases & BTS
  • Captions & copy
( 04 — The results )

Ideabro’s Instagram has grown to 16K followers, backed by a library of launch videos, brand films and explainers that show — rather than tell — what the agency can do.

Audience built
Instagramfollowers
16K
  • 16K Instagram followers
  • A launch, brand-film and explainer video library
  • A clear, differentiated story in AI creative
  • A feed that works as both portfolio and pipeline
( Key learnings )
“When everyone can generate, taste is the differentiator. Show the process, not just the output.”
